generationInputs.prompt: Organize a high-density archival-style visual around the main theme, creating a strong yet contained double reading between the concrete image of the subject and the rigorous text modules. Use an asymmetrical two-column grid. On the main side, place a large black and white image of the subject with touches of selective color. The subject appears from the top with a professional yet relaxed and natural pose: looking forward or slightly to the side, subtle smile, relaxed shoulders, accessible and confident expression, hands visible naturally. Sharp contour and clear details, with the bottom edge smoothly dissolving into a milky white mist that integrates into the paper. Behind the subject, insert subtle thin linear elements (UI/UX icons, nodes, or design symbols) that intertwine, creating depth. Above the blurred area, place an elegant handwritten signature with the name “Luis Ángel Maciel” in an accent color. Use a strong title “Luis Ángel Maciel” and subtitle “Senior UI/UX & Brand Designer”. The right column and the bottom follow a clean design with left alignment, well-spaced modules. Section titles with strong typographic weight, main text in medium-sized rounded sans-serif. Skills with hollow circles, experience level with dots or bars. Experiences separated by years and thin lines. Contact with small icons. Maintain clear typographic hierarchy and good breathing spaces between modules. The gaze should flow naturally from the photo → signature → name → information column. Color style: Main background in a light cream, soft beige, or very light pearl gray (high luminosity and premium feel). The subject's photo in black and white with selective color on skin, hair, and clothing to make it look natural and alive. Main accent color in a modern turquoise blue / cyan or elegant teal, used in the signature, icons, skill dots, and some accents. Add subtle touches of color to icons and graphic elements without oversaturating the design. Paper texture: matte fibrous base with fine gray particles and a light premium paper texture, more visible in white areas and clean in text and image. Maintain a professional, modern, and relaxed look at the same time, with a high-quality editorial air, suitable for printing or digital sharing. Avoid an overloaded appearance. Theme: Curriculum / professional poster of Luis Ángel Maciel – Senior UI/UX & Brand Designer. Complement: Include 3-4 key experience points (UI/UX, Brand Design, Research, Digital Projects). Maintain industry keywords. Format: Vertical 9:10.
